subject: Coriant renewal kickoff — procurement path & QBR windowing
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@coriantlabs.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@coriantlabs.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Coriant renewal conversation & QBR timing

Hi Evelyn (and David),

Thanks for the continued partnership — our contract with Redwood is up at the end of June and leadership has asked us to start a formal renewal/expansion discussion. We're looking to:

- Extend the term 12–24 months (open to options)
- Increase committed capacity ~2x for peak inference workloads starting in Q4
- Tighten the SLA window for critical endpoints

Can you kick off a mutual action plan so we can align procurement and engineering? Key asks from our side: a first-draft SOW we can share with procurement, a high-level pricing delta for the capacity increase, and two preferred QBR dates in late May / early June.

I've copied Liam who owns ops + procurement coordination on our side. If there's someone else from Redwood engineering you want on the thread, please add them.

Thanks — happy to setup a quick 30-min call this week.

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of Platform Partnerships | Coriant Labs
samira.k@coriantlabs.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: none referenced in this message
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@coriantlabs.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@coriantlabs.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coriant renewal conversation & QBR timing

Samira — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Happy to own kickoff and pull in the right internal partners. Proposed next steps and owners below:

1) Mutual action plan (draft) — Evelyn (Redwood) / Liam (Coriant) — deliver by 2027-04-25
2) SOW first draft + pricing delta for 2x capacity — David Kim (engineering/pricing) — deliver by 2027-04-23
3) Procurement checklist & contract intake items — Monica Patel (account ops) — deliver by 2027-04-26
4) QBR and stakeholder readout — schedule for one of these windows:
   - Option A: Tue May 24, 10:00–11:00 PT
   - Option B: Thu May 27, 08:00–09:00 PT

I attached a short starter SOW (Coriant_SOW_draft_v1.pdf) and our procurement checklist (Procurement_Checklist.xlsx) to accelerate. We'll also include a pricing appendix that shows the incremental unit economics for the bumped commit vs on-demand throughput.

Does one of those QBR slots work for your execs? If not, propose two alternatives and we'll lock it. I'll add Karthik Iyer from product (for quantization/throughput guidance) and David to keep the pricing numbers aligned.

On the call we'll: confirm capacity shaping (burst vs reserved), acceptance criteria, and a tentative rollout timeline so procurement has dates to work to.

Thanks — adding a short checklist below for the kickoff meeting so we have a crisp agenda.

Kickoff agenda (30 min):
- Introductions & aim (5 min)
- Contract boundary & desired term (5 min)
- Capacity ask & technical constraints (10 min)
- Procurement milestones & required artifacts (5 min)
- Next steps & owners (5 min)

Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0110

Attachments: Coriant_SOW_draft_v1.pdf, Procurement_Checklist.xlsx
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@coriantlabs.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.k@coriantlabs.com>, Procurement <procurement@coriantlabs.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T08:04:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Coriant renewal conversation & QBR timing

Evelyn — appreciate the fast turnaround and the attachment. Option A (May 24) works best for our team.

Looping in procurement (procurement@coriantlabs.com) — they will need: SOW + pricing appendix + any SOC/attestation docs by 2027-05-10 to hit our internal timeline. Can you confirm if SOC/Security package is the same as last year or if there are updates we should expect?

Also, a quick ask for David: can you include a short table showing the cost impact of using 8-bit quantization vs standard FP16 for the extra capacity (ballpark $/token or $/hour)? That will help our infra team make the case.

Thanks,
Liam O'Neill
Director, Platform Ops | Coriant Labs
liam.oneill@coriantlabs.com

Looping back — thanks everyone for confirming May 24. I've penciled the slot and will send a calendar invite once Liam confirms attendee list.

What I will action this week:
- Finalize procurement intake template and push to procurement@coriantlabs.com by 2027-04-26
- Add a short acceptance criteria appendix to the SOW draft (David / Karthik to review)
- Prep the pricing appendix template David will fill (expected 2027-04-23)

David / Karthik — please flag any blockers on the quantization delta or rollout timeline; if you need a short 20-min sync, I'm happy to schedule it.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
